_comment: QM-0001 test floor, enforced by scripts/verify-baseline.sh. The floor may only ever be RAISED; a task that lowers it is rejected in review. Counts were measured on the commit below by running `cargo test --workspace` and `cd apps/web && npx vitest run`. Derivations for every cli_golden value are in .plan/evidence/QM-0001.md.
_commit_field_note: The _comment above says the counts were measured on `commit`, so this field is repinned in the same change that moves a count. QM-0120 measured rust 598/49 on base d49701c WITH branch task/qm-0120-quantisation-simulation applied on top of it — a count that adds a new crate cannot be measured on a commit that does not contain the crate, so `commit` names the base and this note names the branch. Web counts were NOT re-measured beyond confirming they are unchanged at 115/13, because QM-0120 changed no web file. PRIOR: QM-0030 measured 477/45 on f4fba1e, its implementation commit; 6fb593a ('pin baseline.json to its merge commit') shows the controller may repin this to the merge commit when the branch lands, which is a repin of a true value, not a correction of a false one.
_rust_floor_raised_by: QM-0120 — 545 tests over 45 binaries measured on base d49701c, raised to 598 over 49 after adding the new crate crates/q-quant (quantisation simulation, QUANT-001). The 53 new tests are 45 unit tests in crates/q-quant/src, 7 in crates/q-quant/tests/reference_goldens.rs and 1 in crates/q-quant/tests/allocation_bounds.rs; the 4 new `test result:` lines are those three binaries plus the crate's (empty) doc-test line, which `qm_sum_rust_results` counts as a binary. Derivation in .plan/evidence/QM-0120.md. Web counts are untouched: QM-0120 changed no web file. PRIOR: QM-0030 — 434 tests over 43 binaries measured on base 6fb593a, raised to 477 over 45 after adding the bounded streaming block reader (crates/q-tensor-runtime/tests/bounded_residency.rs and crates/q-tensor-runtime/tests/real_fixture_blocks.rs), derivation in .plan/evidence/QM-0030.md.
_concurrent_floor_note: Two other branches were raising this floor at the same time as QM-0120. 598/49 is what task/qm-0120-quantisation-simulation measures on base d49701c; the controller reconciles the true post-merge value when the branches land.
_cli_golden_provenance: No expected value below was produced by q-cli. Tensor, shard and payload counts and the exact scalar come from fixtures/tiny-llama-2shard/golden.json, generated by Python safetensors==0.8.0. Layer rows and the planned matmul shape are arithmetic over the fixture's own config.json. Block statistics were computed from golden.json's f32 bit patterns. Each value is matched as a substring of the command's whitespace-squeezed stdout.
